principles: The 1925 national sports federation structure and 1967 Ecuadorian Football Association transition establish governance depth but are not direct annual playing-quality measurements.
FIFA Big Count 2006 is gated to 2006+ for participation/access context.
FIFA Professional Football Report 2023 is gated to 2023+ for professional-ecosystem context.
Very large all-player participation is not mechanically converted into elite quality.
No FIFA ranking or tournament outcome is used as a calibration target; 9+ remains world-leading.
